what: Why our Tier 1 rank is stuck, measured at the gate rather than at the metric
when: 2026-10-30, against the live leaderboard pulled the same hour

spider_sr.note: three-way tie at 0.70000 with CHORD Baseline and wte09fl, both ahead on submission time
spider_sr.to_gain: any value above 0.70000, i.e. one clip flipping, lands rank 10 -- two rank points

maniptrans_sr.note: ties do not promote, so 0.53333 is not enough; two clips must flip to reach 0.56667

rank_objective_search.method: The earlier Pareto proof asked whether a swap improves one metric without hurting another. That is the wrong objective -- the challenge ranks by the sum of per-metric ranks, so a swap that spends AUC inside our 0.00625 cushion to buy MPPE past DAP is worth a rank point. Re-ran the search over all 67 held alternative rollouts on 30 clips, scoring every 1-, 2- and 3-swap against the live board.
rank_objective_search.result: no combination lowers the Tier 1 rank sum of 44
rank_objective_search.closest: taking the lowest-MPPE rollout we hold on every clip reaches 12.01783 cm -- 0.0208 cm short of passing DAP -- while holding all three other ranks. 0.63 cm summed across 30 clips is the whole distance to that rank point.

the_finding.headline: Two clips miss the SP-SR gate by a hair, and one SP-SR flip is worth two rank points.

e16.note: position is 8 cm inside the 10 cm limit; it already passes MP-SR, by 0.09 degrees, so the orientation must come down without going up

e05.note: orientation is comfortably inside 0.5 rad; this is a pure position-precision ask on the donor-transfer rollout

the_finding.why_this_was_not_visible_before: Every arm so far was judged on per-clip AUC, and every closure argument was written in metric space. A gate is not a metric: e16 needs 1.3 degrees, not a better AUC, and no amount of AUC bookkeeping shows that.

mp_sr_near_misses.units: cm of mean position error above the 3 cm gate
mp_sr_near_misses.note: MP-SR needs two of these to flip, because 0.53333 only ties wte09fl

what_this_costs.unit: a 50M-step warm start is about 0.63 GPU-hours, so roughly $0.55 per cell at $0.68/h including provisioning
what_this_costs.targeted_set: e16 and e05 for the SP-SR flip, e29 and e11 for the MP-SR pair, two seeds each: 8 cells, about $5
what_this_costs.with_breadth: adding e09 e13 e21 e02: 16 cells, about $9
what_this_costs.upside: +2 ranks on SP-SR, +1 on MP-SR if two flip, +1 on MPPE which 0.63 cm summed would carry: up to 4 of the 86
what_this_costs.honest_odds: low per cell. Second-generation warm starts adopted 0 of 3 before, and e16's own chain rollout fell 0.6469 -> 0.2963. The difference now is the target: a gate flip of 1.3 degrees or 0.32 cm, not an AUC record, so the criterion that failed those arms does not apply. Breadth, not selection, is what pays -- the donor transfer was 3 of 9 and heavy-tailed.

blocked_on: Brev credit. Two creates returned Bad Request; nothing can run until the account is topped up.
corrects: docs/TO_THE_TOP.md and STATUS.md, which said the remaining gap is a better per-clip tracker bought with training scale. That is true of the leaders -- MBZUAI at 0.89354 against our 19 best clips averaging 0.7228 -- and false of the next two ranks, which are 1.3 degrees and 0.32 cm away.
